craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of containment — the Vijñānavāda opponent staged at full strength, then held; śāstra-hammer couplets, negation-anaphora, terminal doctrine words. End-weight blur enacts aviśiṣṭatā — formlessness felt, not stated (row 10). Rejected: (a) stay indistinct → killed: Latinate, unscannable; blur is vyaṅgya. (b) explaining the tie → killed: song shows, never tells. Read aloud: EV-en-SO, BE-ing FITS-on-ly AS-bound … STAY-one-BLUR.

lines: Even so, being fits only as bound to appearing —
cut from that tie, thing and unthing stay one blur.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam apy avabhāsānuṣaktā sattocitā bhavet tadapekṣāṃ vinā bhāvābhāvayor aviśiṣṭatā

reads_against.argmap: What is being, cut loose from appearing? → Being is not free-standing; it is appearing-tied or nothing determinate.
c1_essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).
